 EPAM Romania
 EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.
We are seeking an experienced Senior Cyber Incident Responder to investigate and respond to complex cybersecurity incidents across our organization.
In this role, you will conduct advanced investigations, perform root cause analysis, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our detection and response capabilities. You will also collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, support threat hunting activities, and help strengthen organizational readiness through knowledge-sharing and incident simulations.
 Responsibilities
Respond to complex cybersecurity incidents, ensuring timely investigation, containment, eradication, and recovery
Serve as a senior technical responder during major security incidents, working alongside the Incident Response Manager and key stakeholders throughout the incident lifecycle
Conduct advanced investigations involving endpoint, network, identity, cloud, and application-based threats
Perform root cause analysis and develop actionable recommendations to prevent recurrence
Support digital forensics and evidence collection activities when required
Analyze attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) to understand threat actor activity and improve detection and response capabilities
Collaborate with Cyber Defense, Infrastructure, Cloud, Application, Risk, Legal, Privacy and other business teams during incident investigations
Produce clear and concise incident reports, executive summaries, and post-incident reviews
Contribute to the development and improvement of incident response procedures, playbooks, and operational documentation
Support threat hunting activities and the continuous enhancement of detection and response capabilities
Provide guidance to junior analysts during investigations and participate in knowledge-sharing sessions, workshops, tabletop exercises, and incident simulations
Support Tier 2 by sharing comprehensive company insights and knowledge to enhance operational efficiency
Participate in on-call rotation once a month for 12-hour shifts (passive on-call)
 Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
5+ years of experience in cybersecurity, with significant experience in Incident Response, Digital Forensics, or Security Operations
Hands-on experience responding to and investigating complex cybersecurity incidents
Understanding of incident response methodologies, attack lifecycle concepts, and threat actor tactics and techniques
Background in conducting investigations across endpoint, network, identity, cloud, and enterprise environments
Expertise in performing root cause analysis and developing remediation recommendations
Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills
Capability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Proficiency in creating operational documentation, reports, and technical procedures
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (B2+ level)
